summary: Full backend + frontend regression executed against preview URL. Backend pytest: 28/29 passed (1 failed = stale MongoDB countries collection returning only 14 rows instead of 46). Auth (username/password), /auth/me, /auth/logout, dashboard, AI CRUD + bulk + RBAC, countries PATCH + bulk, provinces (38), server on/off/restart + RBAC, interrogation, users CRUD (create/duplicate/invalid email/short pw/admin-cannot-elevate/status toggle/self-delete guard), activity log, and end-to-end new-user login all pass. Frontend Expo web preview on 390x844: Login (USERNAME tab default) → Dashboard shows 7 AI + Server core + Target Negara. AI toggle flips ON→OFF and last_activity persists. Country search 'jerm' → Jerman (DE), region 'Asia' filter returns 7 countries. Server OFF button opens confirmation sheet (BATAL/MATIKAN). Interrogation returns 10 report rows (connection/api/database + 7 AIs). Access/User form has all 12+ fields; creating KARYAWAN user succeeds and appears in list. Karyawan RBAC verified: 0 AI toggles, no bulk buttons, no server-off visible, Access page shows 'tidak memiliki izin'. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected. Only issue: production DB retains 14-country legacy dataset (seed guard only runs when count==0). No expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage.

minor.issue: Returns only 14 countries; expected ~46 per seed. Legacy MongoDB documents from a prior iteration were never migrated because seed_database() gates on count == 0. Also 'AU' has region 'Oceania' in DB while current code seeds 'Oseania'. This makes UI Country page + interrogation appear incomplete for all users.

integration_issues.issue: Only 14 countries available due to stale DB; UI is correct but data set is incomplete.

action_items: Migrate stale MongoDB countries collection: either drop the collection during startup when the seed list differs, or upsert each country in COUNTRIES so region + full 46-country list is present (fixes both /api/countries count and Oceania → Oseania spelling drift).
Optional cleanup: audit users with orphaned allowed_countries codes (e.g. superadmin shows allowed_countries=48 but only 14 exist).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_database() gates every collection on count == 0, so upgrades to seed data (new countries, region rename) never propagate. Prefer upsert on unique key (`code`) for master data.

server.py /api/users response leaks bulk data via public_user(record) which still contains password_hash key removed only in create (record after model_dump excludes password, so hash added later then filtered). Confirm callers never receive password_hash. (Already handled here but keep in mind for future edits.)
current_user() imports datetime.timezone in-function; fine but could be simplified.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users and delete them via fixture teardown; also created one KARYAWAN via UI (username starts with 'ui_') that remains in DB.

rca_of_issue: /api/countries returns 14 rows because a previous session inserted a truncated country set; the current seed_database() short-circuits on `count_documents({}) != 0`, so the newer 46-country COUNTRIES list is never written. Fix by switching to bulk upsert keyed on `code` (and re-normalising `region`) on every startup for master data collections.
